questions.name: label
questions.instructions: Which category best describes the text? Pick exactly one.

choices.description: Business news: stock markets, earnings, economy, oil and commodities, trade, mergers, airlines, retail and companies outside the technology sector.

Science and technology news: technology companies and their products, earnings or lawsuits (e.g. Microsoft, Google, Apple, IBM, Intel), software, hardware, internet, telecom, video games, space, and scientific or medical research.
Sports news: games, matches, athletes, teams, leagues, scores, transfers and results.
World news: international affairs, politics, governments, elections, wars, conflicts, disasters and crime. Not business, sports or technology.
